senses.gloss:
n. (-नं)
Gifts in honour of deceased ancestors; also निवाप.

f. (-रा)
A virgin, a girl unmarried.
E.
नि priv. and वर a husband.

m. (-रः)
Hindering, opposition, impediment.
E.
नि prefix, वॄ to screen, घञ् aff.

m. (-रः)
1 Trade, traffick.
2 A place, &c. proper for the site of a habitation.
3 A religious mendicant.
n. (-रं)
1 Water.
2 Mud.
E.
णी to obtain, &c. ष्वरच् Uṇādi aff.

m. (-रः)
Rice growing wild or without cultivation.
E.
नि before वृ to be, aff. घञ्.

n. (-नं)
1 Returning, turning or coming back.
2 Bringing back.
3 Reforming, repenting.
4 Desisting from.
5 Giving back, returning.
6 Stopping, ceasing.
7 A measure of land 20 rods, or 200 cubits square.
E.
नि before वृत to be, ल्युट् aff.

mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं)
To be restrained, to be hindered or diverted.
E.
नि before वृत to be, causal v., तव्य aff.

ind.
1 Having desisted or refrained from.
2 Having turned back.
3 Having repented.
4 Having repaid.
E.
नि before ष्टत to be, aff. ल्यप्.

nf. (-णं-णा)
1 Killing, destroying.
2 Removing.
E.
नि before वर्ह to cover, ल्युट् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Killed, destroyed.
2 Removed, taken away.
E.
नि before वर्ह to cover, क्त aff.

mfn. (-सन्-सन्ती-सत्)
Dwelling in, inhabiting.
E.
नि before वस to dwell, शतृ aff.

f. (-तिः)
A house, a habitation.
E.
नि in, वस to dwell, aff. क्तिन्.

m. (-थः)
A village.
E.
नि in, वस to dwell, aff. अथ.

n. (-नं)
1 A house, a habitation.
2 Cloth, clothes, raiment.
E.
नि in, वस to dwell or wear, aff. ल्युट्.

m. (-हः)
1 A multitude, a quantity.
2 One of the seven winds.
E.
नि always, वह to gain, घ or अच् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Well armed, accoutred in strong mail.
2 Secure, safe, as in an asylum.
3 Calm, not windy.
m. (-तः)
An asylum, a dwelling, &c.
2 A calm.
3 Strong armour.
E.
नि neg. वात wind, &c.

m. (-चः)
A demon, the grandson of HIRAṆYAKAŚIPU.
E.
निवात, and कवच a cuirass.

m. (-पः)
1 Gifts in honour of a deceased parent or relative.
2 Offering of water at Śrāddhas, or daily ablution to the manes.
3 Gift, giving in general.
E.
नि before वप to go, to give, &c. aff. घञ्.

n. (-णं)
1 Hindering, opposing.
2 An impediment.
3 Contemning, holding light or worthless.
E.
नि prefix, वॄ to screen, ल्युट् aff.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
To be checked, hindered, &c.
E.
नि before वॄ to screen, aff. अनीयर्; also निवारितव्य and निवार्य्य.

mfn. (-यत्-यन्ती-यत्)
Opposing, hindering.
E.
नि before वॄ to screen, शतृ aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Hindered, checked, opposed.
E.
नि prefix, वॄ to screen, क्त aff.

mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
To be opposed or hindered.
E.
नि before वॄ to screen, pass. v., शानच् aff.

m. (-सः)
A house, a dwelling.
E.
नि in, वस to abide, aff. घञ्.

n. (-यं)
Habitation or inhabiting.
E.
निवास, and भूय being.

mfn. (-सी-सिनी-सि)
Dwelling, abiding in, inhabiting.
E.
निवास, and इनि aff.

mfn. (-डः-डा-डं)
1 Coarse, large, gross, bulky, without spaces or interstices.
2 Thick, impervious, impenetrable.
3 Crooked-nosed.
E.
नि not, विल an interstice, ल changed to ड; or नि particle, with विलच् aff.

mfn. (-षः-षा-षं)
1 Coarse, gross.
2 Crooked-nosed.
E.
see the last; also मि particle, विडीसच् aff.

mfn. (-सन्-सन्ती-सत्^1)
Wishing to stop or return.
E.
नि before वृत to abide, desid. form, शतृ aff.
[1] Correction submitted by Jim Funderburk on 20161216. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/323, batch 315-320.

mfn. (-षः-षा-षं)
Alike, not different.
E.
नि neg. विशेष difference.

mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं)
1 Entered, gone in or into.
2 Seated, sitting upon.
3 Situated or placed in or on.
E.
नि before विश to enter, aff. क्त.

mfn. subst. (-तः-ता-तं)
A veil, a mantle, a wrapper.
n. (-तं)
The Brahminical thread suspended round the neck, in which manner it is worn on some occasions.
E.
नि before व्ये to cover, aff. क्त.

m. (-ती)
A Brahman with the cord suspended round his neck.
E.
निवीत, and इनि aff.

mfn. adj. (-तः-ता-तं)
Surrounded, enclosed, encompassed.
subst.
A veil, a mantle, a wrapper.
E.
नि before वृ to surround, aff. क्त.

mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं)
1 Ceased, stopped.
2 Abstaining from worldly acts, &c.
3 Abstracted from or independant of worldly motives.
3 Desisting from or repenting of any improper conduct.
4 Returned, turned back.
5 Gone, departed.
6 Finished, completed.
E.
नि prohibitory prefix, वृत to be, aff. क्त; see निर्वृत्त.

f. (-तिः)
Covering, enclosing.
E.
नि, वृ to be, क्तिन् aff.

f. (-त्तिः)
1 Cessation, completion, leaving off, rest, repose.
2 Discontinuance of worldly acts, cessation of emotions, separation from the world.
3 Denial, refusal.
4 Abolition, prevention.
5 Returning.
E.
नि negative prefix, वृत to be, aff. क्तिन्: see निर्वृत्ति.

mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
Without further cause or motive.
m. (-णः)
A virtuous man, one uninfluenced by worldly desires.
E.
निवृत्त ceased, कारण cause.

mfn. (-गः-गा-गं)
Of subdued appetites or passions.
E.
निवृत्त stopped, राग passion.

mfn. (-त्तिः-त्तिः-त्ति)
Quitting any practice or occupation.
E.
निवृत्त, and वृत्ति maintenance.

m. (-त्मा)
1 A sage.
2 VIṢṆU.
E.
निवृत्त stopped, (from worldly acts, &c.) आत्मन् spirit.

n. (-नं)
1 Delivering, giving, entrusting, addressing, (either an article, a message, or a speech.)
E.
नि before विद to know, causal form, aff. ल्युट्.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Given, entrusted, addressed, delivered.
2 Represented, stated, told.
E.
नि before विद to know, aff. क्तः see निवेदन.

m. (-शः)
1 Entrance, entering.
2 Delivering, entrusting, depositing.
3 A camp, a palace, the residence of a king or general.
4 Any dwelling.
5 Military array.
6 Ornament, dress, decoration.
7 Marriage.
E.
नि before विश to enter, aff. घञ्.

n. (-नं)
1 Entering, entrance.
2 A house, a habitation.
3 A town or city.
E.
नि before विश to enter, aff. ल्युट्.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
1 To be entered.
2 To be engaged in.
E.
नि before विश to enter, अनीयर् aff; also निवेशितव्य and निवेश्य.

mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्)
Sending in or into, causing to enter.
E.
नि before विश to enter, causal form, शतृ aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Entered into.
2 Engaged in.
3 Sent, directed.
4 Placed in or upon.
5 Turned to or towards, fixed upon.
E.
नि before विश to enter, क्त aff.

n. (-ढं)
Perseverance, resolution.
E.
नि, and व्यूढ arranged.

m. (-कः)
Dearth, scarcity.
E.
नि before वच to speak, aff. घञ्; creating alarm and causing conversation.

f. (-विः-वी)
1 Capital, principal, stock.
2 Stake, wager.
3 A cloth round a woman's waist, or the ends of the cloth passed round the loins so as to hold the whole together; on being loosed the lower members are exposed: the tie of drawers worn by women, &c.
4 The outer tie of a packet, in which the offerings of a Śūdra at funeral obsequies are presented.
E.
नि before व्येञ् to cover, Uṇādi aff. इन् and ङीष् optionally added; the इ of नि is made long, and the radical finals rejected.

mfn. (-वृत्)
Any inhabited country.
E.
नि always, वृत to be, aff. क्विप्, and the vowel of the prefix made long.

n. (-व्रं)
1 The edge of a thatch.
2 The circumference of a wheel.
3 A wood.
4 The moon.
5 The constellation Revatī.
E.
नि certainly, वृ to be, aff. क, deriv. irr.; also नीध्र.
